share.amountHint: An estimate: this share of the pool's total balance, read at {{time}} UTC. The balance is read again when an operation opens, and the pool grants less when less is free. It is margin; the position is this amount times the account's leverage.
share.pairMinimumNote: Each pair also has a minimum order at the exchange, which depends on its price and on the account's leverage. The panel does not check it. A signal whose order would be too small is refused and nothing is opened.
share.notNumber: Enter a number, for example 25 or 33.5.

share.tooManyDecimals: A share has at most 18 decimal places.

keys.title: Exchange keys
keys.intro: One key per exchange. Keys are encrypted on the server and never shown again; you only see the last four characters.
keys.error: Exchange keys could not be loaded.
keys.stale: This list could not be refreshed and may be out of date.
keys.poolsUnknown: The pools could not be loaded, so an exchange without a key is not marked here.

card.facts: What is known about this key
card.confirmedHint: "Confirmed" is what you told this panel on that day. {{exchange}} does not let the panel check what a key may do, so orders are sent on your confirmation. If the key cannot trade futures, {{exchange}} rejects the first live order and you get a Telegram alert. Nothing checks the withdrawal setting.
card.unrecordedHint: Stored before the system recorded how a key was checked. Enter it again to have it checked.
card.readOnly: This key cannot trade. With dry run off, opening signals for {{exchange}} are refused until you add a key that can trade futures.
card.degraded: No key stored. With dry run off, opening signals for {{exchange}} are refused until a key is added.
card.empty: No key stored. Add one to read and trade on {{exchange}} from here.
card.notServed: The {{exchange}} key is managed outside this panel, on the server. It cannot be added, replaced or deleted here.
card.savedPending: The rest of this card appears when the list has been read again.

form.helpVerified: Before saving, the key is tried with a real read at {{exchange}}. A key that can withdraw funds is refused. A key that cannot trade is saved with a warning.
form.helpConfirmed: Before saving, the key is tried with a real read at {{exchange}}. {{exchange}} does not let this panel check what the key may do, so you confirm it here.
form.replaceNote: Saving replaces the key stored now, also when the new key cannot trade.

confirm.withdrawals_disabled_confirmed: I confirmed in {{exchange}} that this key has withdrawals disabled
confirm.futures_enabled_confirmed: I confirmed in {{exchange}} that this key has Enable Futures
confirm.help: If the key lacks Enable Futures, {{exchange}} rejects the first live order and you get a Telegram alert. Nothing checks the withdrawal setting: it rests on your word.

form.emptied: The fields were emptied. Enter the key again to retry.

error.keyRejected: {{exchange}} did not accept this key. Check that the key and the secret were copied whole, that the key has not expired, and that it allows this server's IP address. Nothing was saved.
error.withdrawPermission: This key can take funds out of the account, so it was refused. Create a key without withdrawal permission and enter that one. Nothing was saved.
error.permissionsUnavailable: {{exchange}} did not say what this key is allowed to do, so it was not saved. Try again in a moment.
error.venueUnreachable: {{exchange}} could not be reached, so the key was not checked and not saved. Nothing is known to be wrong with it. Try again.
error.concurrentSave: Another save for {{exchange}} finished first, so this one was not stored. The card shows the key that is stored now. Check it before saving again.
error.confirmationRequired: The key was not saved, and nothing was sent to {{exchange}}, because a confirmation is missing:
error.confirmationRequiredUnlisted: The key was not saved, and nothing was sent to {{exchange}}, because a confirmation is missing. Tick both and enter the key again.
error.confirmationNotApplicable: The panel sent a confirmation that {{exchange}} does not take, so the key was not saved. Reload the page and enter the key again.
error.notServed: {{exchange}} keys are not managed by this panel, so nothing was saved.
error.storageUnavailable: The server cannot store keys right now, so nothing was saved. If this repeats, the server's encryption key is missing or unusable and has to be fixed there.
error.invalidKey: The API key cannot be stored as typed. A key has 4 to 256 characters and no spaces or accented letters. Nothing was sent to {{exchange}}.
error.invalidSecret: The API secret cannot be stored as typed. A secret has at most 256 characters and no spaces or accented letters. Nothing was sent to {{exchange}}.
error.invalidRequest: The server refused the request as malformed, so nothing was saved. Reload the page and enter the key again.
error.noAnswer: No answer came back from the server, so it is not known whether the key was saved. The card shows what is stored now.
error.unknown: The save ended in a way this panel cannot read (status {{status}}), so it is not known whether the key was saved. The card shows what is stored now.

delete.confirmBody: The key ending in {{last4}} is removed from this system. {{exchange}} is no longer read or traded from here until a key is added again. Its history stays.
delete.condition: The server allows this only while every {{exchange}} strategy is disabled and nothing is open on it.

errors.notFlat: The {{exchange}} key cannot be deleted yet. This is in the way:
errors.notFlatUnlisted: The {{exchange}} key cannot be deleted yet: a strategy is still enabled, a position is open or an order is in progress.
errors.gone: The server found no {{exchange}} key to delete. Close this: the card shows what is stored now.
errors.unknown: The delete ended in a way this panel cannot read. Close this: the card shows whether the key is still stored.
